title: Video Brief
description: Creative brief produced by the Idea Explorer agent.

style.description: Style playbook name or custom description

niche.description: Selected documentary niche/domain, e.g., 'history', 'technology', 'money and power'

platform_title_style.description: Title style determined by target_platform. viral = curiosity-driven hooks; documentary = restrained documentary style; brand = brand-safe corporate style.

reference_material.description: Paths or URLs to source material

hook.description: Concrete hook: date, name, number, or place

sub_niche.description: Sub-niche tag to ensure no two options fall in the same sub-territory

angle_options.description: Candidate video angles produced by the idea stage. Count is dynamic, not fixed.

candidate_count.description: Number of candidate angles actually generated

candidate_count_reason.description: Human-readable reason for the chosen candidate count (e.g., 'high-breadth domain generated 25 options')

background_color.description: Global background color or tone, e.g., '#08050a' or 'dark moody studio background'

lighting_style.description: Global lighting constraints, e.g., 'chiaroscuro, strong specular highlights'

design_system.description: Visual constraints locked before generating any assets

composition_rule.description: DOM layout rule for HyperFrames (e.g., 'Position asset in left flex column, text in right'). DO NOT bake spatial layout into image prompts.

motion_rule.description: Camera or subject motion, e.g., 'subtle pan left to match HTML entry'
